fact: A technical validation workshop held in Bangui on 23-25 April 2024 on the national civil registration policy, under the EU-funded, CIVIPOL-supported project to modernise civil registration, was meant to enable a national strategy for civil registration statistics linked to the national statistics development strategy and a statistical bulletin; the source named is civil registration, and no edition of statistics is published.
title: Centrafrique : Validation technique du document de politique nationale d'état civil
